inv.desc_en:
ESSEIN CONSULTING REAL ESTATE LUXURY presents this bright, renovated COMMERCIAL SPACE WITH SOUTH FACING orientation in one of the most exclusive areas of the city, SARRIA-SAN GERVASI DISTRICT on Ronda General Mitre near Muntaner.
